recon.description:
Recon lets you share a video or link from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and other apps. Gemini examines its frames and audio to identify what appears or gets mentioned. Recon then checks the results against GitHub and Wikipedia to help you find real sources.
⠀
Instead of just guessing, it explains whether an item was spoken, shown on screen, or inferred—and how well it matched. Your analysis history stays on your phone, with no separate Recon server.
⠀
✨ Highlights
• Share video links or files
• Discover apps, books, places, repos & products
• Matched sources and detection details
